protocol.catalogue_assumption: Product metadata catalogue is fixed and available transductively; product introduction dates are unavailable.

learned.selection: Seed-0 hyperparameters and each seed checkpoint selected by full supplied validation NDCG@20; no test selection

selected.stress_test_policy: All settings selected on the original validation masks, then frozen for all test cases

timing.scope: CPU; fixed precomputed source embeddings/metadata. External embedding pretraining/extraction excluded. Peak RSS is whole-worker, not per-method.
